faq.question: What is CouponSite?
faq.answer: CouponSite (formerly 优惠总动员 / Coupon Hub) is a promo code and official sale page aggregator covering 15 brands including Nike, Adidas, ASOS, Amazon, Sephora, Steam, Booking.com, Walmart and Target, across fashion, electronics, travel, and beauty. Some outbound links are affiliate links; the service is free for shoppers.

faq.question: Are the coupon codes free to use?
faq.answer: Yes. All coupon codes on CouponSite are free to view and use. No signup or payment required.

faq.question: How do I use a coupon code?
faq.answer: Three steps: 1) Find the coupon you want on the homepage or merchant page; 2) Click the Copy Code button if a code is shown; 3) Paste the code into the promo code box at checkout on the brand's website to apply the discount.

faq.question: Do coupon codes expire?
faq.answer: Yes. Promotions rotate frequently. Where a brand runs a promotion without a fixed code, we list the official sale page instead and mark it as continuously updated rather than giving a date. Where a code has an expiry date, the card shows it.

faq.question: How do I verify a coupon code is still valid?
faq.answer: Every active entry is manually reviewed before it is published, and ended promotions are removed promptly. If you find one that no longer works, please report it on the contact page and we will check and pull it.

faq.question: Does the site support English?
faq.answer: Yes. The site is bilingual in English and Chinese. Merchant pages and coupon details are available in both.

faq.question: What is an affiliate link?
faq.answer: An affiliate link is a tracked promotion link. When you click through from CouponSite and complete a purchase, the brand pays us a small commission at no extra cost to you. You pay exactly the same price as visiting the brand directly.

faq.question: How do I use the discount calculator?
faq.answer: Open the Discount Calculator from the top navigation. Enter the original price and discount percentage, and the calculator instantly returns the final price and the amount saved.

faq.question: How can I get updates on new coupons?
faq.answer: Subscribe to our RSS feed (/rss.xml) for automatic updates when new entries are published. You can also visit the blog (/blog) for regularly curated money-saving guides.

faq.question: How do I contact CouponSite?
faq.answer: Use the contact page (/contact) or email czhcl@hotmail.com. We typically reply within one to two business days.

faq.question: Where is your privacy policy?
faq.answer: It is at /privacy. The terms of use are at /terms, and the contact details are at /contact.
